description: Source file implementing MKLDNN (oneDNN) tensor utilities and wrappers for PyTorch, including functions for data type conversion, tensor creation from data pointers, and tensor views, as well as internal class definitions for tensor handle management.

classes.name: IntrusivePtrTargetWrapper
classes.description: Template class wrapping a custom tensor handle, inheriting from c10::intrusive_ptr_target for use with intrusive pointers.

methods.name: get_mkldnn_dtype
methods.description: Converts a ScalarType to the corresponding oneDNN data type.

methods.name: data_ptr_from_mkldnn
methods.description: Retrieves the data pointer from an MKLDNN tensor.

methods.name: mkldnn_tensor_from_data_ptr
methods.description: Creates an MKLDNN tensor from a raw data pointer and metadata.

methods.name: new_with_itensor_mkldnn
methods.description: Constructs a PyTorch tensor from an ideep::tensor, with optional dtype and device.

methods.name: itensor_from_mkldnn
methods.description: Extracts an ideep::tensor reference from an MKLDNN tensor.

methods.name: nbytes_from_mkldnn
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of an MKLDNN tensor.

methods.name: itensor_view_from_dense
methods.description: Creates an ideep::tensor view from a dense CPU tensor.

methods.name: itensor_from_tensor
methods.description: Gets an ideep::tensor from a PyTorch tensor, either by view or from MKLDNN.

methods.name: set_verbose
methods.description: Sets verbosity level for ideep (oneDNN) debugging.
